params.caption: 🎮 Blizzard thins out overcrowded zones in WoW: Forever Blizzard says some zones in World of Warcraft: Forever had become too crowded, so it has lowered the player population in the most congested areas. The studio says it will keep monitoring how zones feel as the launch rush continues. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 14:47 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ #WorldOfWarcraft #WoWForever #GamingNews
